unresolved: Countries JP/US and initial si/messages/small-files use are selected; local sites, measurable targets and country-specific profiles remain unset
Hardware, compliance, contract, sharing permission and hard caps not confirmed
Real Wi-Fi, satellite, closed enclosure, battery and invoice tests not run

privacy: Store only anonymous identifiers and hashes in Git; never credentials, IMSI/ICCID, personal account data or private packet contents.

measurementDefinitions.window: UTC start/end plus local monotonic elapsed seconds; numerator and denominator evidence belong to this same window
measurementDefinitions.successFraction: successCount / attemptCount; attempts > 0, a predetermined bounded payload/checksum and timeout define success; count retries and loss separately
measurementDefinitions.goodput: verified application payload bytes * 8 / measured monotonic window seconds per direction; do not substitute PHY maximum or provider billable bytes
measurementDefinitions.latency: client application request to verified response round-trip milliseconds; record all sample timings in external evidence and report nearest-rank p95 with sample count; timeouts recorded separately, not removed from successFraction
measurementDefinitions.runtime: monotonic minutes from undocking without external power to the predeclared stop threshold; retain mode/power trace
measurementDefinitions.stop: same owner stop-request monotonic timestamp to independently observed local nft fence, AP disabled/no forwarding, and provider-confirmed network fence; provider request acknowledgement is not proof of the fence
measurementDefinitions.unknown: unknown provider status uses null providerStopLatencyMs plus providerStopStatus=unknown and unresolved reservation; never zero or success
measurementDefinitions.targets: all required targets and definitions fixed before execution; null/unmeasured fields cannot pass acceptance
measurementDefinitions.region: Each run binds exactly one JP or US country profile; both independent regional acceptances are needed for the dual-region claim. Region/use-case choice alone never authorizes purchase, contract, RF or charge.
